blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

claim_audit.phenotype: NCBI ARVC Introduction/Evaluation supports ventricular arrhythmias often associated with exercise, right-precordial T-wave inversion, right-ventricular structural abnormalities, fibrofatty replacement, and use of cardiac magnetic resonance.
claim_audit.correct_gene_and_structure: MedlinePlus ARVC Causes and PKP2 Normal Function directly support that PKP2 encodes plakophilin-2, a desmosomal component; desmosomes attach cardiomyocytes to one another and provide mechanical strength.
claim_audit.downstream_pathology: MedlinePlus ARVC Causes/PKP2 ARVC section directly supports defective desmosomes causing cardiomyocyte detachment/death under stress with progressive fat and scar replacement and electrical instability.
claim_audit.distractor_1: MedlinePlus nonsyndromic hypertrophic cardiomyopathy Causes supports sarcomeric proteins such as MYH7/MYBPC3 as major HCM mechanisms.
claim_audit.distractor_2: NCBI Brugada Syndrome supports impaired SCN5A-mediated cardiac sodium current as a Brugada mechanism rather than a PKP2 desmosomal defect.
claim_audit.distractor_3: MedlinePlus RYR2 Normal Function/CPVT supports sarcoplasmic-reticulum calcium release and RYR2-related CPVT; it does not describe the direct function of PKP2.
claim_audit.distractor_4: MedlinePlus DMD Normal Function/X-linked dilated cardiomyopathy supports dystrophin linkage of cytoskeleton to extracellular matrix and cardiac disease from DMD variants.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Exertional arrhythmia/syncope, right-ventricular structural disease, fibrofatty replacement, and a pathogenic PKP2 variant identify a desmosomal arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. PKP2 function localizes the direct defect to desmosome-mediated intercellular adhesion.
adversarial_second_pass.gene_specificity_check: The lead-in asks for the cellular function impaired by the identified PKP2 variant, not for a generic mechanism capable of causing ventricular arrhythmia. This removes alternate inherited-arrhythmia mechanisms as defensible answers.
adversarial_second_pass.ryr2_challenge: RYR2-mediated calcium handling can cause inherited ventricular arrhythmias and has historical associations with arrhythmogenic phenotypes, but it is not the direct molecular function of the explicitly identified PKP2 variant.
adversarial_second_pass.sarcomere_challenge: Sarcomeric dysfunction is a principal HCM mechanism and does not match PKP2/desmosomal biology.
adversarial_second_pass.sodium_channel_challenge: SCN5A sodium-current defects cause channelopathy phenotypes such as Brugada syndrome, not the direct function of PKP2.
adversarial_second_pass.dystrophin_challenge: Dystrophin anchors cytoskeleton to extracellular matrix and can cause dilated cardiomyopathy; it is molecularly distinct from plakophilin-2/desmosomes.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No diagnostic cutoff, prevalence estimate, dose, treatment threshold, or universal management rule is required by the item.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: All five options are cellular functions of comparable grammatical form and plausible cardiac relevance; the correct option is not identifiable by wording length or category mismatch.
